name: Kamino Kenzou
source:
A game director with a reputation for creating rape and humiliation games. He is an impulsive man who has physical relations with several voice actors, and in return, he offers them jobs.

He is a perverted man who enjoys ripping off stockings and playing with images of humiliating situations. He is always forcing Sayoko Himuro, one of the voice actors he takes care of, to do image play.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio3/index.html]official site[/url]]
